scope_limitations: Scope covers only Deut 11:17 (הארץ הטובה) through 11:21 (כימי השמים על הארץ:), block 3 words 54–102, physical rows 8–15. The full page, the batch, Unicode encoding and export are not covered.

I compared against the block 3 text in candidate.json. That file describes itself as a draft. Its words 44 and 102 match the corrected state in s8_occurrence_correction.json, but I did not read working/s8.json or candidates/s8_pointed.json directly.

Even at 3×, some mark positions can't be pinned to a single letter. For qadma and meteg in particular, I checked that the mark is present and has the right shape, but where it falls on a junction between two letters, the host can't be told from the image alone. This applies to the qadma in וּקְשַׁרְתֶּ֨ם (w65, row 9), which sits near the resh/tav junction and is accepted as tav only provisionally, and to the hosts in M1 and M2.
I didn't check shin versus sin dot placement or the placement of holam on the Divine Name beyond confirming that a dot is present.
Words cut at slice edges were read in the overlapping slice. The one exception is the second view of לְטוֹטָפֹת in row10-part1, which stays too close to the edge to confirm M2.
